scope: Independent semantic and source-integrity review of two candidate entries. This is a review receipt only, not a canonical publication receipt. Original draft reviewer fields are unchanged.

resolvedIssues.detail: Both durations are exact official Chinese text only: elementary 2学期 and intermediate 1学期. No invented English exact wording or month conversion.
Transcripts and notarized academic certificate are explicitly separated; translations of either document require notarization when the original is neither Chinese nor English.

checks.detail: Independently recomputed raw/text SHA-256, checked receipt byte count, HTTP 200, identical official requested/final URLs, and checked every quoted field against both saved text and independently parsed raw HTML.
Elementary/intermediate are explicit tracks with distinct official lengths; both are language training, not academic degrees. English + Chinese teaching is explicit.
HSK levels are under 项目目标, not admission thresholds. Draft correctly uses entry-test placement and says no mandatory HSK entrance score is specified rather than asserting unconditional eligibility.

Tuition period, 14000 annual alternative, 400 application fee, non-refundability and payment after preliminary review agree. January 1 is an explicitly named end date; competing 日前 wording is disclosed and applicants are advised to apply early. opensOn remains unknown rather than substituting capture/publication date.

Passport expiry beyond September 2027, notarized academic certificate, translated non-Chinese/non-English documents, six-month complete medical form with required seals and signatures, financial evidence, local-authority noncriminal record, under-18 guardian documents, and in-China current visa/residence-permit copies are preserved.

The plain-text official URL and navigation login href support https://admission.swjtu.edu.cn. One body hyperlink has a malformed punycode href, which was not followed or used; canonical proposal correctly uses the explicitly printed official host.
